The 32-bit execution state used by the native XNU research on the Cortex-A53. Application instruction support alone does not establish kernel compatibility.
Application binary interface: the concrete calling, layout and preservation rules that independently compiled components must agree on.
The Allwinner SoC used by the original PinePhone in this research. It is not the PinePhone Pro platform.
A producer encountering limited capacity in a downstream queue or sink. It needs an explicit admission and progress policy.
The runtime structure through which a loader supplies the kernel with memory and platform context.
A launchd log message used during research. Its absence from a console is insufficient evidence that userspace failed to progress.
The legacy shared graphics-surface service observed in this build. Source storage must be distinguished from active display scanout.
A memory policy in which a write to a shared mapping can require a private copy. Compatibility operations must preserve that behavior.
A structure describing a memory region or translation. In this atlas, a page-table descriptor and an IOKit memory descriptor are different objects.
Structured platform metadata. The Apple-format tree given to XNU is distinct from the native board FDT, and its live contents can differ from the archive.
Flattened device tree: a board-description format used in the native platform environment, separate from the inspected legacy Apple tree format.
A filesystem consistency check. A full-volume check is stronger than reading the clean-unmount bit, but does not prove arbitrary power-loss durability.
Generic Interrupt Controller: part of the native A64 interrupt-delivery path, with different semantics from the original Samsung platform's controllers.
A member of the HFS Plus filesystem family used by the inspected volumes. The native adapter retains the original kernel filesystem implementation.
Human Interface Device. The research follows the original event-service and client paths for button and touch delivery.
XNU's object, registry and driver-service framework. Construction, registration, matching and client operations are separate observable steps.
The original audio family required by the inspected media client. Publishing a compatible output does not establish sound playback.
The common original framebuffer interface retained around native presentation behavior in the display experiments.
Low-resolution analog-to-digital input used for the PinePhone volume-key ladder in the recorded button experiment.
The original iPhone product profile. Its 4A102 archive shares a kernelcache with N45AP while differing in board and root-image contents.
The original PowerVR graphics family associated with the Apple reference hardware. A setup-frame result does not certify general MBX command coverage.
Memory Management Unit: the translation and access-control machinery between a task's virtual address and a physical target.
The first-generation iPod touch profile used as the working original-device reference in this research.
A deliberately wrong or absent condition that should make a test reject the result. It checks whether the observer can detect the failure of interest.
Power-enable key events exposed by the PMIC. These supply the physical Power-button input in the accepted native experiment.
Power-management integrated circuit. Its target-state measurements help distinguish USB input availability, charging and peripheral power.
Selecting and making a frame available to the display path. It is distinct from rendering the source pixels and from device scanout timing.
The deliberately partial native-board model used to test selected A64 interfaces and original-client integrations.
The active pixel storage consumed by the display engine. Its lifetime and visibility are different from those of an application's source surface.
The original user-interface process studied through service startup, rendering, dimming and input response. A process being alive does not imply a complete UI session.
An obsolete ARM memory-exchange instruction observed in original userspace. Correct compatibility requires more than instruction decoding.
The units and counter used to represent time. A stale frequency declaration can change the real duration of delays and timeouts.
The display's vertical blank interval. A software notification or completed memory copy is not automatically evidence of physical VBlank synchronization.
Wait For Interrupt. Time spent waiting is evidence about CPU activity, not a complete measurement of board power or charging.
The kernel family underlying the target software. This research studies the measured 933-era ARM binary and native adaptations, not a recovered complete source tree.
The PinePhone rear image sensor. Its available modes are separate from the VGA mode accepted in this native port.
Packed 4:2:2 YUV: two luma samples share chroma in a four-byte pixel pair.
The point at which the renderer no longer owns an image and its storage can safely be reused.
Capacity kept available for fresh input while other surfaces remain retained downstream.
The rate of newly selected camera images, separate from delivery or repeated display updates.
The original power-source service consumed by userspace; synthetic consumer validation and physical battery measurement are separate evidence.
The Quectel cellular modem physically present in the original PinePhone. Its integration with this native userspace is unaccepted.
